inputClasses: unsigned VRM bytes (git-tracked mtoon_default.vrm when present, else 8 KB synthetic)
passing QA report bound to those bytes
inspection records for the exact hash
configured Ed25519 signer and trust policy

parameterRanges.signer: configured signer reference (never a private key)
parameterRanges.out: bundle directory that does not exist unless replace

invariants: the happy path signs the frozen bytes and writes the 12-file bundle (VRM, C2PA sidecar and ingredients, editable project, lock, QA and inspections) with no leftover temp directory; the input VRM bytes are never altered
an unknown or keyless signer, or a nonexistent trust policy, is incomplete/MISSING_CREDENTIAL with no bundle and no receipt; an untrusted signer is gateFailed/UNTRUSTED_SIGNER with no bundle
a report bound to other bytes is REPORT_MISMATCH, a failing report is GATE_FAILED, a missing report is incomplete/MISSING_INPUT; none writes a bundle
missing or uncertain inspection coverage and an unresolved rights declaration block delivery
a replay is byte-identical; a changed payload under the same requestId is REQUEST_ID_REUSED with no second bundle; an existing out directory is an invalid request unless replace
production-eligible only when every command it invokes is production-eligible
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass

mutants.description: testDeliverWithUnknownSignerIsIncompleteWithoutBundle: an unknown or keyless signer and a missing trust policy must be incomplete/MISSING_CREDENTIAL with no bundle, no receipt and the source hash unchanged.
testDeliverWithUntrustedSignerFailsWithoutBundle: a signer outside the trust policy must be gateFailed/UNTRUSTED_SIGNER with no bundle.
testDeliverRequiresPassingReportForExactBytes: a report for other bytes, a failing report and a missing report must each block delivery.
testDeliverRequiresInspectionCoverageAndResolvedRights: missing or uncertain inspection coverage and an unresolved declaration must block delivery.

testDeliverHappyPathSignsFrozenBytesAndWritesBundle: a replay must be byte-identical; a changed payload under the same requestId must be REQUEST_ID_REUSED with no delivery-2 directory; an existing out directory must be rejected without replace.

A report envelope claiming every DeliverPackTests test passed (executed 6, failed 0, exit 0) whose oracleHashes name a Tests/VRMAuthorKitTests/Provenance/DeliverPackTests.swift other than the pinned one. The runner's report-acceptance path must refuse it before any assertion runs.

visual.applicabilityRecord: deliver is a signing and bundling transaction over already-verified bytes and never renders a frame, so no view, motion or landmark can change its result. Recorded by the acceptance author (claude-fable-5-1); the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.

canonicalArtifacts: resultHash: sha256 of the canonical result manifest
